verdict.rationale: Lovable's core product is an AI assistant/agent that autonomously builds full applications from natural-language prompts, with a dedicated 'Build mode' (formerly Agent mode) that 'takes ownership of execution end to end' and lets users steer work asynchronously, plus chat-driven database/auth generation. Community evidence confirms users heavily delegate real tasks (prototyping, dashboards) to it, though with quality caveats on generated code.
